item.title: TimeBot Jr. 0.3.42
item.description:
• A ticket now shows its description right under the title, so you can see what it's about without scrolling. Notes read as plain text, and the "Assigned" lines are gone.
  • My time is now two columns. The calendar and your day stay on the left, and the form or ticket you open shows on the right.
  • Days in the future only take PTO now.
  • Every screen now says "Book time", where it used to be a mix of Log time, Add time and Save time.
  • Support desk folds repeat emails and alerts from the same client into one row with a count. You can pick the whole group at once to close or assign it.
  • Tickets you've picked in a list stay picked when you open one and come back. While anything is picked, a click picks or unpicks, and a double-click opens.
  • Merging tickets keeps you on the list and tells you what merged into what.
  • Sort in My tickets has a direction button, and it remembers your choice.
  • A ticket opened beside a list has a clear Close button, and Esc closes it too.
  • Sign out now asks first if you have a timer running or time waiting to send.
  • Several fixes make sure time is never booked twice and never lands in the future.

item.title: TimeBot Jr. 0.3.41
item.description:
• You can now start a new ticket right from Add time in My time. Pick New ticket in the switch at the top, or click "Not in the list? Make a new ticket" under the ticket list, and its time goes on the same day.
  • Time you've booked ahead, like PTO, now shows on the My time calendar with its hours.

item.title: TimeBot Jr. 0.3.40
item.description:
• Delete an entry: the pencil on an entry now has Delete. It asks first, and it can't touch a submitted week.
  • My time shows a number when you're behind: workdays in the last two weeks with no client time and less than a full day booked. It turns orange, then red at four, and shows on the app icon too.
  • Easter eggs!

item.title: TimeBot Jr. 0.3.39
item.description:
• Fix an entry's day: the pencil on an entry now lets you move it to another day, at the same time of day (up to 90 days back).
  • If that week's timesheet is already submitted, it tells you so plainly instead of a vague error.

item.title: TimeBot Jr. 0.3.38
item.description:
• Log time is simpler: hours, your note and Save, with one line like "Today · Remote · Billable". Click that line to change the day, work type or billing.
  • My time has one Add button for ticket time, internal time, a new ticket or PTO. New ticket from My time books on the day you're looking at.
  • New ticket's Book time now lets you pick the day, up to 90 days back.
  • Support desk (managers and Marina): click a ticket to read it, again to open it beside the list. Tick several to assign or close them at once.
  • Time on this ticket and the set-once settings fold away until you want them.
  • The hours in the sidebar always match the day underneath.

item.title: TimeBot Jr. 0.3.37
item.description:
• After hours and Emergency work takes a start and stop time, booked into ConnectWise as the real window.
  • My time's Add time now has work type, billing, the site visit fee, the site, and start/stop for after hours.

item.title: TimeBot Jr. 0.3.36
item.description:
• New ticket says "Use that one?" when a ticket like it is already open at that client, with a button to open it instead.
  • On the iPhone, getting in the car (CarPlay via a Shortcut) pauses the timer and asks whether to book the time.

item.title: TimeBot Jr. 0.3.35
item.description:
• Warns when a note looks like work you already booked on another ticket at that client in the last 5 days
  • Asks before booking a maintenance ticket as any other work type
  • To review flags both of those
  • Client profiles show Other Consultants

item.title: TimeBot Jr. 0.3.34
item.description: App Metrics is tidier: headline numbers on top, then Sources, Habits and People tabs

item.title: TimeBot Jr. 0.3.33
item.description: App Metrics shows whether people log more after switching to the app

item.title: TimeBot Jr. 0.3.32
item.description:
• Warns you before saving what looks like a duplicate entry
  • App Metrics shows adoption, speed, quality and health

item.title: TimeBot Jr. 0.3.31
item.description: Refinement of duplicate booking logic for time review

item.title: TimeBot Jr. 0.3.30
item.description:
• My numbers shows the PTO you have left this year
  • Team shows everyone's PTO left (managers)
  • To review: a Consultant filter, and every manager is in the whose-clients menu
  • Dropdowns open in the app's own style

item.title: TimeBot Jr. 0.3.29
item.description: To review: help another manager by picking their clients from the menu (My clients is still the default)

item.title: TimeBot Jr. 0.3.28
item.description:
• To review: pick several entries with Shift-click or Cmd-click and mark them together
  • To review: fix a ticket's title while reviewing
  • To review: only entries on a submitted time sheet show up
  • To review: every group has a Mark reviewed button, one entry or many

item.title: TimeBot Jr. 0.3.27
item.description:
• My numbers on My time: your own hours, billable and utilization, folded away until you click it
  • Breadcrumbs above every ticket and client page, each step a link back
  • All tickets is tidier: the list and filters on one line, Views as links underneath
  • Search says every open item; the sidebar says My tickets

item.title: TimeBot Jr. 0.3.26
item.description:
• All tickets (was Search all): filter by person, board and priority, with shared views and your own saved ones
  • Client pages show a Health card: critical and old tickets, the last planning meeting, and past-due invoices for managers
  • Tickets show their location (Remote or Onsite) and the client's site, which opens in Maps
  • To review can sort by consultant, client or date
  • Newer features carry a Beta tag
  • The main window stays on its own Space and can go full screen
  • The Clients filters load faster and are remembered

item.title: TimeBot Jr. 0.3.25
item.description:
• Search any ticket: Open, Unassigned, Closed, Everything, or Stenhouse inbox (emailed in from unknown senders)
  • Search also matches the contact's name
  • Merge tickets: tick them, then Merge into, or right-click one to merge the others into it
  • Choose which ticket to keep from a list
  • My tickets shows how old each ticket is, its priority, and the newest note

item.title: TimeBot Jr. 0.3.24
item.description: Close now uses the right close status on every board (>Closed* on Service Desk) and never cancels a ticket by mistake

item.title: TimeBot Jr. 0.3.23
item.description:
• New Appearance options in Settings: Transparency (Solid, A little, Normal) and High contrast
  • When ConnectWise refuses something, the message now shows ConnectWise's own reason

item.title: TimeBot Jr. 0.3.21
item.description:
• Demo mode now saves for real. It only hides the Managers group (To review, Team, App Metrics)
  • The sidebar says Demo mode: Managers hidden while it's on

item.title: TimeBot Jr. 0.3.20
item.description: Demo mode for managers (Settings > Demo): hides the Managers group and saves nothing to ConnectWise, for showing the app to the team

item.title: TimeBot Jr. 0.3.19
item.description:
• Clearer messages when ConnectWise refuses a change: they now name your own ConnectWise role and the setting to change
  • Editing a saved time entry explains a refusal instead of showing a raw error

item.title: TimeBot Jr. 0.3.18
item.description:
• To review: notes are spellchecked, and likely typos show under the entry so they can be fixed before the client sees them
  • Names, acronyms, web addresses and everyday IT words are not flagged

item.title: TimeBot Jr. 0.3.17
item.description:
• Quotes and orders: orders grouped by whose move it is (us, the client, the vendor)
  • Orange flags on orders stuck too long: overdue invoices, POs not received, sales orders with no invoice
  • See what's in each order, and track shipments with one click
  • POs with no order listed on their own, so you can find out whose they are
  • Change a sales order's status, mark PO items received, and write the client into a PO's notes
  • The Quotes button shows how many orders are waiting on us, and each client's page lists their orders
  • Change a Quote board ticket's stage right from its bar

item.title: TimeBot Jr. 0.3.16
item.description: A new time entry no longer looks pre-filled: the shortcut to reuse your last note on a ticket is now a labeled link under the note box.

item.title: TimeBot Jr. 0.3.15
item.description: Quotes now opens on Orders: every CPQ order with the client's name, where it's at (waiting on client payment, waiting on the vendor and so on), and its quote, sales order, invoice and POs one click away. The double-booked flag in To review is gone.

item.title: TimeBot Jr. 0.3.14
item.description: Quotes is now Quotes and orders: one bar per order with the client's name, the CPQ quote number and where it's at (step 5 of 12 and so on). Sort by client or furthest along, and search by client, quote number or ticket.

item.title: TimeBot Jr. 0.3.13
item.description: New for managers and Marina, under Support in the sidebar: Support desk (unassigned Service Desk tickets, the whole board with filters, and the Monitoring board) and Quotes (the Quote board by stage, with quiet quotes flagged).

item.title: TimeBot Jr. 0.3.12
item.description: The sidebar is now grouped: Your work, then Managers (managers only), then Settings.

item.title: TimeBot Jr. 0.3.11
item.description: To review: managers can now fix an entry's hours and note too, not just billing and work type (while it's Open or waiting for approval). New flags for double-booked time and billing that doesn't fit the work. Mark reviewed is now Cmd-Return on the Mac and Ctrl+Enter on Windows.

item.title: TimeBot Jr. 0.3.10
item.description: In My time, picking another day now closes the ticket that was open beside the calendar.

item.title: TimeBot Jr. 0.3.9
item.description: Right-click any day on the My time calendar (week or month) to show it, log time or internal time on it, book PTO from it, or mark it as a day you didn't work.

item.title: TimeBot Jr. 0.3.8
item.description: New: an Internal time button under New ticket, for admin, overhead and meetings. On a ticket, Time on this ticket now lists every booking with Edit (hours, note, work type, billing) until its timesheet is submitted. In To review, Save fix only saves a billing or work type change without marking the entry reviewed.

item.title: TimeBot Jr. 0.3.7
item.description: To review now shows only ticket time (internal Admin and PTO are left out), grouped by consultant and week. Mark all reviewed does a consultant's whole week at once, and the To review button shows how many of your clients' entries are waiting.

item.title: TimeBot Jr. 0.3.6
item.description: New for managers: To review in the sidebar. Every unreviewed time entry for your clients, oldest first; fix billing or work type and mark it reviewed in one click. Everyone: an orange flag on My time when Onsite work has no site visit fee, or a site visit fee sits on work that isn't Onsite.

item.title: TimeBot Jr. 0.3.5
item.description: Fix: if a save's answer gets lost on a slow connection, the retry now finds the entry that already landed instead of booking it twice.

item.title: TimeBot Jr. 0.3.4
item.description: Polish: a refused offline save can be sent again (Try again) or dropped from the sidebar; your last note on a ticket is one click away; the new ticket summary counts to 100; the text size slider reaches everything.

item.title: TimeBot Jr. 0.3.3
item.description: Review fixes across the app (saves can't double post on a slow VPN, offline saves keep retrying, sign out clears everything, search matches any word, My time fixes). New: End of day reminder in Settings, and an Auto theme that follows the Mac's light or dark mode.

item.title: TimeBot Jr. 0.3.2
item.description: New: if you're away from the Mac for 15 minutes (or it sleeps) while a timer runs, the app asks when you're back: keep the time, drop the away time, or pause the timer at when you left. Change or turn it off in Settings > Time entry.

item.title: TimeBot Jr. 0.3.1
item.description: New: Cleanup in the sidebar (Cmd-8). It lists your open tickets that look stale (open 30+ days with no time logged, or nobody has touched them in 2+ weeks), with a short reason under each. Tick the ones that are done and close them together; nobody is emailed. Keep hides one for 30 days.

item.title: TimeBot Jr. 0.3.0
item.description: Change a saved entry's hours or note (the pencil on My time), open tickets in their own windows, and File > New Window for a second window.

item.title: TimeBot Jr. 0.3.0
item.description: Faster start: your ticket list shows up as soon as ConnectWise answers, and the rest fills in behind it.

item.title: TimeBot Jr. 0.3.0
item.description: Sort My tickets, close tickets straight from the right-click menu (or several at once), a site picker on new tickets for multi-site clients, and fixes.

item.title: TimeBot Jr. 0.3.0
item.description: Updates itself from now on: TimeBot Jr. > Check for Updates, or it checks once a day. Team goes to five exact usernames. Never saves time in the future or more than 90 days back.
